title: Zoe documentary banner
description: A 24px-rounded warm-cream panel promoting a film: a tall photo (with its title art) filling the left half, and on the right a tall condensed all-caps headline and a navy button. On phones the headline and button centre above the photo. The photo fades in as it enters view.
notes: the headline uses the theme-only --zoe-condensed face (Antonio), falling back to the display face
the film's title art belongs in the photo slot, as on the original
